keyConflicts.derived: 7.88 (not offered). Yearly beta-weighted totals are 11.17, −0.88 and 12.48 (python3). Basel II TSA floors a negative annual aggregate at zero and keeps three in the denominator, which gives 23.65/3 = 7.883.
keyConflicts.why: No option matches the Basel-correct figure. D (7.59) is what you get by carrying the negative year through, and it is the figure the page and the answer key intend. A (11.83) comes from a BIA-style exclusion from both numerator and denominator, which is wrong under the TSA. I am not certain that any offered option is right, so I kept D. The errata blockquote at the top of the solution and the D analysis already explain the discrepancy and give 7.88.
